trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the reward for finishing the whole list: collect the other 54 trophies first and it unlocks by itself. The full set is single-player only, with no online play or extra content required. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. It unlocks on its own when the mission ends, so simply follow the story. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. The award lands as Chapter 2 opens with its first mission, What's in the Bag? Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. It unlocks once Chapter 3 begins with its first mission, Welcome to Vice City. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. It unlocks after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. It unlocks after the chapter's final mission, Starting From Zero. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the game's final mission, Starting From Zero at the end of Chapter 4 — the same mission that closes the chapter. It is the gold story award, so there is no extra step beyond beating the story. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Play the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks automatically when the mission is done. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Play the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist. It unlocks automatically when the mission is done. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Play the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play. It unlocks automatically when the mission is done. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Play the Chapter 4 mission Headliners. It unlocks automatically when the mission is done. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Play the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown. It unlocks automatically when the mission is done. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Play the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory. It unlocks automatically when the mission is done. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% Completion, tracked under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion. The checklist only appears after the story, but progress made during the story still counts, and the list is roughly 60% of true completion. It takes optional missions, vehicle scans, animal studies, stunts and challenges — see the roadmap steps for the full breakdown. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts out of 397 in the game. They split into 130 stunt jumps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps; full completion asks for 300, so you can stop at 250 here. Watch the count under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts, and use the Stunt Spots filter on the map to find them. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race, a race challenge or a Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Track them on the touchpad under Progress, then Activities. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every one of the 42 shooting range challenges, spread across 12 range locations. Replay any challenge until the gold medal lands — each one counts once it is gold. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations, 42 races in total. You need a win at every spot, not just one win anywhere, so work through the locations one by one. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. There are 40 unique race locations, so pick the ones that suit you and take first place in 20 of them. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he will text you and a purple marker appears on the map. Follow his fishing questline and beat him in the fishing challenge at the end of it. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any one arcade game all the way through its levels. There are four to choose from: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind on the TV at home from Chapter 1, and Bang For Your Buck on an arcade machine. Pick the one you enjoy most and clear every level once. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's questline, which is Lucia-only and opens in Chapter 3 when Andy calls, with the address in Belville. Work through its five quests — Climbing the Cellerichain in three parts, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach! where you join the Cellerica initiation, Read the Label where you retrieve the Cellerica van, and Puff Puff Pass at the warehouse — and the final one earns this. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's questline. It starts in Chapter 1 after the mission Island Dreams, where you work for Kenton, and his green KR marker sits at Key Lento. Dive for seven shipwreck treasures with the metal detector, and follow the count under Progress, then Characters, then Kenton Rees, or Collections, then Kenton's Treasures. The line goes quiet from Chapter 1 into Chapters 2 and 3 and comes back later, so it is not missable. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's questline, which opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Play through its five quests — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler where you steal the Impaler, and Hometown Heroes — and the last one earns this. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight stranger mission strands. The ones that count are Kirk's Skunk Ape hunts, Kyle's farm and chemical jobs, Yago's street-race mentoring, and Pilot Pete's delivery runs. Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count toward the eight, and the guide notes more strangers may still be undiscovered, so stick to the four named strands. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's questline. It opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for Randy, and that unlocks the Key Cloner. Then steal the 16 cars on his wish list — tracked under Map, then Robberies, then Randy's Wish List, with his green RK marker west of Vice City — starting with the Zorrusso itself and including the Vitello, Infernus, Windsor Drop, Toros, Tempesta, Paragon, Jagular, Jubilee, Itali RSX, Growler, Gauntlet Hellfire, Furia, Dubsta, Banshee and Baller ST-D. Bringing a car in good shape pays better. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's questline, which is Jason-only. After the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty, a purple marker appears at the Synthetic Labs in Vice City: wreck the lab in Take Out Kitty Litter, then play the quest Spin On This, shutting the labs down. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations — two per spot when Jason and Lucia do it together. Track them under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. POTENTIALLY MISSABLE: the Chapter 1 meditation at Jason's home, after the mission Down to Earth, when Lucia is in the kitchen in the morning — step onto the balcony and accept. The guide is not yet sure that spot is required for this trophy, and full completion only asks for 15 of 18, but do it in Chapter 1 anyway to be safe. This is the list's only potentially missable trophy. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret, a Jason-only questline. After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, Bret Vogel texts you and the quest Veteran Hunted, meeting Bret, opens in Lummox County. Take the unique rifle Killtelligence SM-69 from the weapon locker before you go. There are 15 targets in the deck in total, and all 15 count toward full completion; the exact animal that triggers this trophy is still being confirmed. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete three collectible card sets. The cards sit at 18 set locations around Leonida, so gather full sets one at a time until three are done. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app to scan 100 locations — hold Up, then R1, at each spot. The tally covers 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, with no flusher tags, and more than 100 spots exist, so you have room to pick the easy ones. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges out of 80 in the game — full completion asks for 70, so you can stop at 50 here. Follow the count under Progress, then Challenges, and pick the challenges that fit what you are already doing. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a four-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then get out of the heat zone. You need free-roam as a pair, which opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break — call your partner by holding Right and Triangle. Escape on a fast sports bike, for example through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County. It also unlocks by itself during the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is…, waiting at the cafe, which ends in a bank vault robbery. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops in a row with your partner, without letting the wanted level drop. This opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. Keep the wanted level flashing red and blue rather than solid red heat, and bring a bulletproof vest and sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation, plus Zombix or Adrenaline. A handy run is the three jewellery shops north of Vice City, once the Chapter 3 Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs missions are done; the unlock can take about 30 seconds after you leave the third shop. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them with the WAiNK app — hold Up, then R1. There are 557 vehicles at release, and the quickest way is to stand on a busy road and scan the traffic going past. Full completion asks for 200 base models, so you can stop at 100 here; watch the count on the touchpad under Progress, then Vehicles. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies during one use of Combat Focus — press L3 and R3 together while aiming, and watch the purple focus bar. Boost it first by eating or drinking, washing your face or showering, or taking Adrenaline by holding L1 and then Triangle. Gather five enemies at a Gang Operation and use a strong rifle such as the Duke 556. It does not work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus runs from level 1 to 4 and rises through shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane that is docked at a terminal at VCIA, connected to a boarding bridge — not a plane sitting out on the field. Gates E3 and E4 are the easiest. Climb to the cockpit on the upper floor, reverse onto the runway, take off and fly one kilometre clear of the airport. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank from Mile Zero Air Station, on the island in the south-west of the map in Mariana County. The tanks sit in the south of the base — grab one and drive it out. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewellery store without being spotted. This opens after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which unlocks the Snap Gun and jewellery robberies. Slip in through the back door, open locks quietly with the Snap Gun, and look for the safe-code note in the back room. Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City is a good first target. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape. It starts with the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is…, waiting at the cafe: tail the security van to the bank, the guard opens the vault, bring your partner and hold Right to hand over the bag. After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 for security-van tips — his purple marker needs his earlier quests done, including robbing two Payday Loans. Expect a four-star wanted level at once, so leave on a fast bike and swap vehicles. There are eight big bank jobs in total, all eight count toward full completion, and one bank can pay up to $205,000. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. It counts by itself in the same Chapter 4 mission as Maximum Withdrawal, where robbing the big bank vault qualifies. Or do it earlier: ambush an armored truck near a bank in Vice City, stick a bomb on its rear door, then get clear of the red heat radius. Sticky bombs come from behind Yasmani's shop once his quest is done. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore the whole of Leonida until the map is fully uncovered — 52 areas. The fastest way is by plane, flying over the black fogged patches until none are left. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the nine gangs — one per gang is enough, though all 39 operations count toward full completion. A yellow marker shows on the map when you get close, and the tally sits under Progress, then Gangs. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: NOT YET CONFIRMED AT RELEASE (PowerPyx, 19 Nov 2026). The official description says to enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, but no reliable method was known when the game launched, so this guide will not guess one. Check the linked PowerPyx guide for updates. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: NOT YET CONFIRMED AT RELEASE (PowerPyx, 19 Nov 2026). The official description says to smash your way out of a classic-style vehicle showroom, but no reliable method was known when the game launched, so this guide will not guess one. Check the linked PowerPyx guide for updates. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal three key items at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, a gang operation, then get away. Buy sticky bombs at Ammu-Nation first. The three items are a luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on the north-east table, and a safe in the north-east corridor office, which you blow open with a sticky bomb. The trophy unlocks after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item. It ties to the optional Chapter 2 mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, and the marker comes back much later if you miss it, so it is not missable. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Get Jason and Lucia to maximum strength at the same time — check it on the touchpad under Jason and Lucia, then Strength, marked with a heart. This opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. Train together by calling your partner with Right held plus Triangle, buy a fitness club membership, and note that while one of you trains, the other gains progress too. Find gyms with the map filter for Activities, marked with a dumbbell. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make 500 actions that shape your criminal profile — the running count shows when you select the trophy in the list. Turn the counter on under Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, then Criminal Profile, and a devil-face icon appears at the right of the screen for each action that counts. Profiles range from Professional for clean stealth and escapes, through Hardened and Violent, to Psycho and the permanent Irredeemable for extreme violence. Most of it builds passively as you play; if you fall short, hitting civilians or police adds to it. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: NOT YET CONFIRMED AT RELEASE (PowerPyx, 19 Nov 2026). The official description reads 'Second time's the charm', and a link to the Payday Loans shops from the prologue has been suggested but not confirmed, so this guide will not guess a method. Check the linked PowerPyx guide for updates. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: NOT YET CONFIRMED AT RELEASE (PowerPyx, 19 Nov 2026). The official description reads 'What the hell just happened?', and a UFO questline has been suggested but not confirmed, so this guide will not guess a method. Check the linked PowerPyx guide for updates. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: NOT YET CONFIRMED AT RELEASE (PowerPyx, 19 Nov 2026). The official description says to bowl enemies over with a melee drive-by, and kicking enemies while riding a motorbike has been suggested but not confirmed, so this guide will not guess a method. Check the linked PowerPyx guide for updates. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering marked bills through your contacts. After the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check, meeting Raul's crew, the Dye Pack Jammer opens. Rob banks and Payday Loans, then carry the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The total is cumulative, and one bank vault can hold up to $205,000. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The fastest way is weapons, car mods and tattoos. Shops in the game include 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo parlours and 15 electronics stores — spend anywhere, it all counts. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all eight purchasable garage properties, for $160,000 in total — the four garages from the story do not count. It opens after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, stealing the Crawler for Moses, when the Vice City Real Estate app appears on the phone. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. The app opens after the Chapter 2 mission Moses, taking a vehicle to Moses. You need a garage first, since each garage adds parking slots. Bring a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn, then in the garage choose Respray and Register. At first only vehicles without a tracker can be registered; from Chapter 3 a standard tracker can be fitted at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registration costs money, so use cheap cars and bikes. Source: PowerPyx.
